guidanceConsulted.query: popover dialog light dismiss accessible dismissal behavior
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: closedby="any" + showModal() is the declarative light-dismiss pattern; style ::backdrop; use aria-labelledby; do not rely on click for critical pre-close logic — listen for close/cancel events.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the examples section uses closedby="any" with showModal() and notes that light dismiss still routes through the close watcher so cancel/close fire as before; the dialog-algorithm section documents the ::backdrop hit-test note verbatim.

guidanceConsulted.query: popover dialog light dismiss accessible dismissal behavior
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native Dialog/Popover semantics and keep documents resilient static HTML with semantic structure.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: page is fully static semantic HTML (no JS), blockquote/ol/table semantics for spec quotes, algorithms, and compat data.

guidanceConsulted.query: reference documentation page responsive tables code blocks no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table/thead/th foundation inside an overflow wrapper so tabular data stays readable and navigable on small screens.
